Her right fingertips check the thread end on the supported book; her nearer left arm hangs slightly away from her torso, with the elbow softly bent and the hand beside her thigh. She wears a warm ochre sleeveless rib-knit top; its fine vertical ribs lightly contact the side and lower abdomen and bend with those curves. The hem meets the waistband of dark straight-cut trousers below the rounded belly. Frame her from head to mid-thigh in a three-quarter side view, with her face turned slightly toward the camera and her gaze settling on the book. Soft reflected window light reveals the knit contour and the rounded arm, with natural skin texture and warm quiet presence. Rainwater glints along the threshold behind the low work surface.

Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three.
